entries.question: Garbage, recycling or bulk pickup in the Village of Pelham?
details: Area A (Pelville, Chester Park): garbage Monday; bulk on Mondays, twice a month; recycling Thursday.
Area B (Pelham Heights, Pelhamwood): garbage Tuesday; bulk on Tuesdays, twice a month; recycling Friday.
Apartments and commercial (Fifth Avenue, Wolfs Lane, Lincoln Avenue): garbage Monday, Wednesday and Friday; bulk on Wednesdays, twice a month; recycling Thursday.
Remaining 2026 bulk dates — Area A: October 19, November 2 and 16, December 7 and 28. Area B: October 20, November 4 and 17, December 8 and 29.
Organic yard waste: Wednesdays, May 6 to October 7 (the 2026 season has ended).
Leaf collection, loose leaves only: March 15 to April 30 and October 15 to December 15.
No collection on holidays, including Election Day, November 3, 2026; see pelhamny.gov for the holiday list.
The Recycle Coach app gives a personalized schedule.

entries.question: Garbage, recycling or leaf pickup in Pelham Manor?
entries.note: Schedule and regulations approved by the Board of Trustees July 21, 2025
details: Garbage, collected from the rear yard twice a week: north of Boston Post Road Mondays and Thursdays; south Tuesdays and Fridays.
Commingled recycling: north of Boston Post Road Thursdays; south Fridays.
Garden refuse: north Mondays; south Tuesdays.
Appliances and metal: the first Wednesday of each month.
Unbagged leaves: March 15 to April 15 and October 15 to December 15.
Put items at the road no earlier than 7pm the night before collection.
No collection on holidays and no paper recycling in holiday weeks; collections move a day (see the schedule PDF on pelhammanor.gov).
The Recycle Coach app gives a personalized schedule.
